The present Claim petition arises out of road accident in which Sh. Sita Ram, aged about 50 years suffered fatal injury resulting in his death.

At that time, a truck, bearing no. UP61 AT 2711 (hereinafter referred to as "the offending vehicle") came at a high speed, in an uncontrolled, rash and negligent manner and hit one Smt. Tara Devi who was sitting outside her house near a door.
After stricking Smt. Tara Devi, the said offending vehicle hit the victim Sita Ram, a child namely Ansh (aged 02 years) who was playing near the site and three buffaloes.
Thereafter, the offending truck hit against an electricity pole.
3. While victim Smt Tara died on the spot, victim Sita Ram succumbed to the injuries and died on his way to the hospital.
Victim Ansh sustained injuries.

Two out of the three buffaloes,
died on the spot.
